subject.title: Add optional `name`/`label` field to group config entries

question: Should OpenClaw add a metadata-only group-entry field, and if so should the canonical key be `label` and which opaque-ID group, room, and channel maps must support it?
rationale: This adds a new public config surface across several channel-owned contracts, and `name` may conflict conceptually with existing runtime name-matching behavior; repository evidence cannot determine the intended permanent API name or scope.

options.title: Standardize `label` metadata
options.body: Add optional `label` to opaque-ID group-like entries across supported channels and guarantee that runtime matching and authorization ignore it.

options.title: Standardize `name` metadata
options.body: Use `name` to align with account display-name conventions, while documenting and testing that it is not a runtime lookup key.

options.title: Keep comments and discovery tools
options.body: Decline another config field and instead improve group-ID discovery or schema/UI presentation while relying on JSON5 comments for manual annotations.

recommendation.title: Standardize `label` metadata
recommendation.body: Add optional `label` to opaque-ID group-like entries across supported channels and guarantee that runtime matching and authorization ignore it.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available routing candidate from central config history and prior issue review context.
